never_collected: file names, archive URLs or local paths

guidance.HEX-PERM-SHIZUKU-001: Grant HEX GFX permission in Shizuku, then retry.
guidance.HEX-PERM-SHIZUKU-002: Confirm Shizuku is running and reopen Storage Permission.
guidance.HEX-PERM-SAF-001: Reopen Storage Permission and try the Android folder picker again.
guidance.HEX-PERM-SAF-003: Grant both read and write access, then use the selected folder.
guidance.HEX-PERM-SAF-004: Remove the old folder grant and grant access again.
guidance.HEX-SHIZUKU-STATE-001: Start Shizuku again before applying the skin.
guidance.HEX-SHIZUKU-PERM-001: Grant Shizuku permission to HEX GFX again.
guidance.HEX-SHIZUKU-DIR-001: Start Mobile Legends once and retry; otherwise re-check Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-SHIZUKU-DIR-002: Confirm Shizuku is active and the game assets folder exists.
guidance.HEX-SHIZUKU-WRITE-001: Restart Shizuku, verify free storage and retry the same skin.
guidance.HEX-SAF-PERM-001: The saved grant expired. Grant the Mobile Legends files folder again.
guidance.HEX-SAF-GRANT-001: Remove the invalid folder grant and select the folder again.
guidance.HEX-SAF-TARGET-001: Start Mobile Legends once, then re-grant the folder and retry.
guidance.HEX-SAF-DIR-001: Android blocked a required folder. Re-grant access or use Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-SAF-FILE-001: Android blocked creation of the skin file. Re-grant access or use Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-SAF-STREAM-001: The saved folder cannot be written. Re-grant access or use Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-SAF-WRITE-001: Check free storage and folder access, then retry.
guidance.HEX-SAF-WRITE-002: Re-grant folder access and verify that the skin ZIP is valid.
guidance.HEX-LEGACY-PERM-001: Grant storage access or select another permission method.
guidance.HEX-LEGACY-DIR-001: The legacy destination is unavailable; use Secondary or Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-LEGACY-DIR-002: Android blocked folder creation; use Secondary or Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-LEGACY-WRITE-001: Android blocked legacy writing; use Secondary or Shizuku.
guidance.HEX-ARCHIVE-MISSING-001: Check the skin link and internet connection, then retry.
guidance.HEX-ARCHIVE-EMPTY-001: Replace the ZIP with an archive containing usable skin files.
guidance.HEX-ARCHIVE-READ-001: The downloaded ZIP is damaged or unsupported. Replace the file.
guidance.HEX-CYBER-INPUT-001: Restart HEX GFX and retry the operation.
guidance.HEX-CYBER-MODE-001: Open Storage Permission and select a supported access mode.
guidance.HEX-CYBER-IO-001: Verify the ZIP, storage space and selected permission, then retry.
guidance.HEX-CYBER-UNKNOWN-001: Copy the report and inspect the latest PermissionHub/CyberTask state.
guidance.HEX-UNKNOWN-001: Copy the report and inspect the latest PermissionHub/CyberTask state.
